attributes.name: ypy-multipart:connect
attributes.description: Opens a long-lived `multipart/mixed` or `multipart/parallel` response with a GET request to the URL, on the element's `ypy-trigger` (default `load`). Each part is swapped like a response and may carry `YPY-*` headers of its own. The connection reconnects with backoff, sends `YPY-Last-Part-ID` and pauses while the tab is in the background.

attributes.name: ypy-multipart:close
attributes.description: Closes the connection when this event fires on the element.

events.name: ypy:multipart:before:connection
events.description: Fires before a multipart connection is used, and again before each reconnect. Cancel it, or set `detail.connection.cancelled = true`, to stop.

events.name: ypy:multipart:after:connection
events.description: Fires when a multipart response was accepted, on the first connection and after each successful reconnect.

events.name: ypy:multipart:before:part
events.description: Fires for each part before it is handled. Cancel it, or set `detail.cancelled = true`, to skip the part. `detail.waitUntil(promise)` delays handling.

events.name: ypy:multipart:after:part
events.description: Fires after a part was swapped or its header actions ran. The part id then counts as received for reconnects.

events.name: ypy:multipart:error
events.description: Fires when a connection attempt, a reconnect or the parsing of the stream fails. `detail.status` is set when a reconnect got an unusable response.

events.name: ypy:multipart:close
events.description: Fires once when the connection is cleaned up. `detail.reason` is `cancelled`, `ended`, `removed`, `part` (a `ypy-multipart:close` event fired) or `cleanup`.

headers.name: YPY-Last-Part-ID
headers.description: Sent on a reconnect: the id (`YPY-Part-ID`) of the last part that was fully handled, so the server can resume after it.

headers.name: YPY-Part-ID
headers.description: Part header: identifies the part. Once the part and all the parts before it were handled, its value becomes the next `YPY-Last-Part-ID`.

headers.name: YPY-Swap
headers.description: Part or response header: the swap style for this part (the whole stream when set on the response). `YPY-Reswap` wins over it.

headers.name: YPY-Select
headers.description: Part or response header: the selector of the content to swap for this part. `YPY-Reselect` wins over it.

headers.name: YPY-Push
headers.description: Alias of `YPY-Push-Url` accepted on a part or on the multipart response.

config.name: multipart
config.description: Defaults of the ypy-multipart extension. A single request overrides them with `ypy-config='{"multipart":{...}}'`.

config.name: multipart.reconnect
config.description: Reconnect after the stream ends or fails. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` for a stream opened by a request.

config.name: multipart.reconnectDelay
config.description: Wait before the first reconnect, in ms or as an interval string. The wait doubles on each attempt up to `reconnectMaxDelay`.

config.name: multipart.reconnectMaxDelay
config.description: Longest wait between two reconnect attempts, in ms or as an interval string.

config.name: multipart.reconnectMaxAttempts
config.description: How many consecutive reconnect attempts are made before giving up. Unlimited by default.

config.name: multipart.reconnectJitter
config.description: Random spread applied to each reconnect delay, as a fraction of the delay (0.3 is plus or minus 30%). `0` turns it off.

config.name: multipart.connectTimeout
config.description: Timeout of a connection attempt, in ms or as an interval string. `0` waits without limit. Defaults to `ypy.config.defaultTimeout`.

config.name: multipart.pauseOnBackground
config.description: Close the connection while the tab is hidden and reconnect when it is visible again. The default is `true` for an element with `ypy-multipart:connect` and `false` otherwise.
